mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen in three of the four weeks into t-0w (-27.9 to -18.0), and this upward momentum persists: the gradual reopening trajectory carries retail-and-recreation footfall higher over the next four weeks relative to the trailing four-week mean of -21.8.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly mean rose from -27.9 at t-3w to -18.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: The forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the trailing 28-day mean of -21.8.

mechanism_narrative: The 10.4-point single-week jump in WORKPLACES from -26.0 at t-1w to -15.6 at t-0w marks an office and commuter return that restores weekday trip-chaining, and this always-on commuter channel lifts RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES jumped from -26.0 at t-1w to -15.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: The forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the trailing mean whenever the WORKPLACES weekly mean exceeds -20 percent.

mechanism_narrative: A 16.4-point week-on-week retreat in PARKS from -4.6 to -21.0 shows households re-restricting discretionary outdoor trips; that renewed caution spills into non-essential commerce and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls more than 10 points week-on-week (observed -4.6 at t-1w to -21.0 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 16.4 points between t-1w and t-0w
regime_hint: renewed household caution inside partial reopening
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the week following any week-on-week PARKS drop greater than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL declining over four consecutive weeks (13.6 to 9.9) together with WORKPLACES rising (-26.0 to -15.6) is a home-to-work substitution signal; hours released from staying home are reallocated partly to retail-and-recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean declines while WORKPLACES weekly mean rises in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell 13.6 to 9.9 while WORKPLACES rose -26.0 to -15.6 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: When the joint RESIDENTIAL-down and WORKPLACES-up condition holds, the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean does not exceed the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under Delhi's graded reopening, TRANSIT tracks the relaxation of movement orders and GROCERY_PHARM sitting at baseline (-1.3) shows trips are still mostly essential; every point of TRANSIT recovery unlocks suppressed non-essential retail trips, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean improves (less negative) for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -47.6 to -39.0 while GROCERY_PHARM stayed near baseline across t-3w to t-0w
regime_hint: policy relaxation / graded reopening with transit still suppressed
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over four weeks while TRANSIT improves for two consecutive weeks and GROCERY_PHARM stays within plus or minus 3 points of baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has stalled in a narrow band (-41.4, -41.0, -39.0) for three weeks, indicating a hard ceiling on non-essential travel; while transit stays pinned below -35, retail-and-recreation cannot sustain gains and RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean remains below -35 percent for three consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly means were -41.4, -41.0 and -39.0 for t-2w through t-0w
regime_hint: stalled reopening with a travel-demand ceiling
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the following week while the TRANSIT weekly mean remains below -35 percent.

mechanism_narrative: Monsoon onset suppresses PARKS from -4.6 to -21.0, displacing outdoor leisure into covered commercial and retail venues; this seasonal indoor substitution raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks even without further policy relaxation.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -15 (monsoon-onset threshold)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped from -4.6 at t-1w to -21.0 at t-0w, crossing the -15 level
regime_hint: June monsoon onset inside a reopening phase
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the two weeks following a PARKS weekly mean below -15.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean stays above +9 percent for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL readings were 13.6, 11.3, 10.6 and 9.9, never dropping below +9
regime_hint: partial containment re-imposition with sticky work-from-home
